questions.question: According to the Union Ministry of External Affairs, how many Indians remain missing in the recent flash floods in Nepal?

questions.question: What caused the catastrophic flash flooding in a border area of China and Nepal, according to preliminary reports?
options: An enormous ice-and-rock landslide and glacier collapse in Tibet
Heavy monsoon rains intensified by a Western Disturbance
A severe earthquake along the Himalayan fault line
A breach in a major hydroelectric dam on the Gandak river
questions.explanation: The catastrophic flash flooding in a border area of China and Nepal was caused by an enormous ice-and-rock landslide and a glacier collapse in Tibet. This event generated a 'tsunami of dirt' that swept down mountain passes, gathering ice, water, rock, trees, and dirt.
questions.background: Initially, there were reports of seismic activity, but the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) later clarified that the event was a glacial collapse and debris flow, not an earthquake. Such events highlight the increasing risks posed by climate change in glaciated regions.
questions.examRelevance: Nepal-China flash floods cause = glacier collapse and ice-and-rock landslide in Tibet.

questions.question: What is the Congress party's reiterated position regarding the strength of the Lok Sabha seats during discussions on delimitation?
options: It supports increasing the Lok Sabha seats to 700
It proposes reducing the Lok Sabha seats to 450
It opposes any decision to change the strength of the Lok Sabha beyond 543 seats
It supports keeping the Lok Sabha strength beyond 543 seats unchanged
questions.explanation: The Congress party has reiterated its position that it doesn’t support any decision to change the strength of the Lok Sabha beyond 543 seats. The last major delimitation exercise in India was based on the 2001 Census, with a freeze on the number of Lok Sabha seats until 2026, based on the 1971 Census.
